selection_basis: Ex ante topic/horizon relevance, independent of prices, returns or significance. All classified US election, policy and political/earnings mention records; a named macro family panel for inflation, jobs, growth, energy, housing and the Fed. The full classified inventory remains available separately.
not_in_core: Recurring 15-minute/hourly oil direction ladders and other trading-clock contracts remain in the full extraction. Their listing and turnover frequency is not evidence of growing electoral salience.
interpretation: A completely processed research cohort, not a claim of complete historical extraction of every website category. Sparse or absent quotes remain explicit. No selection on realized equity returns.
